annotations.title: Audit a website’s ad conversion tracking

description: AUDIT ANY WEBSITE'S AD CONVERSION TRACKING (a pixel checker): Hermoso loads the page in a real browser, the way a visitor does, and reports which pixels and tags are on it (Meta Pixel, Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, TikTok, LinkedIn Insight, Pinterest, Snap, Reddit, X, Microsoft UET, ChatGPT Ads, the Hermoso tag) with their ids; whether each FIRES a page view; DUPLICATE installs (two page views for one load, Meta's own 'Duplicate Pixel ID'); BROKEN installs (failed requests, a Content-Security-Policy blocking a pixel, a pixel that loads and sends nothing); CONSENT problems (Google Consent Mode missing or v1, the consent default set after the tags, pixels firing before the cookie banner is answered; the scan accepts the banner and records before and after); missing PURCHASE or LEAD events (on a checkout, thank-you or sign-up page, or a store with none set up); and any visible SERVER-SIDE path (server-side Tag Manager, a Conversions API gateway, Elevar or Stape, a store app that sends server events). A score out of 100 and a grade, then every problem with a plain-language fix, a way to check it yourself and, where Hermoso can make the fix, the tool that does it; plus fixPrompt, a prompt to hand a coding agent. Use it for 'check my facebook pixel', 'is my pixel working', 'audit my tracking', or a competitor's site. url defaults to the brand's website. Each audit is stored per domain (get_conversion_audit reads it back). Takes 10 to 40 seconds. Free. SIDE EFFECT: it WRITES, it is not a pure read: each audit stores its report and refreshes the previous stored audit for that domain (what get_conversion_audit and the shareable report show) and creates a shareable public report link; it changes nothing on the audited site and nothing in any ad account.

url.description: any page: a homepage, product, checkout, thank-you or sign-up page; default the brand's website
